title: Path information and a derivative hedge limit
instructions: Use only the supplied synthetic information and the conversation history. Return strict JSON with question_id, turn, answers and evidence. answers maps every declared output to its typed value; evidence maps each output to a list of supporting source IDs available so far. Cite all and only the sources supporting that output; unsupported, unknown, repeated or future source IDs lose citation credit. Numbers use the declared units and tolerances; do not round intermediate calculations. Arrays require exact length and the requested order; strings use exact labels and booleans must be JSON true/false. Optional rationale is not automatically graded. Preserve prior constraints unless the user explicitly changes them. Distinguish stipulated scenarios from observed facts or forecasts. No trading, network access or proprietary query execution is required.
user_message: Assess whether endpoint-only data and an initial delta support the analyst’s valuation and loss-limit claim. Compute both admissible witness outcomes, including the paid premium, and state what the observations identify. Do not treat a diagnostic path as an observed realization. All packet facts are synthetic. Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. Return the declared outputs and the supporting packet IDs; do not infer market probabilities or unstated permissions.

sources.text: Synthetic packet: The synthetic trade ticket supplies barrier terms and premium. The price record has only endpoints; the two interior paths are constructed witnesses consistent with that record, not extra observations.

Synthetic governing terms: The option is a long up-and-out call, extinguished without rebate if any monitored price is at least barrier. Each supplied path lists all monitoring times in order. Only initial and terminal spots were actually observed in the available packet; both supplied interior paths are hypothetical admissible diagnostics. Static hedge means short delta shares established at initial spot and held unchanged; short-sale proceeds are retained. Rates, dividends and transaction costs are zero.
